generator: the AlgoLift app, scripts/indicators/classics/fixtures.mts (the strategy node's formula)
note: The AlgoLift strategy node's own formula on the cases TA-Lib was compared on (talib/adx.json, PLUS_DI+MINUS_DI+DX+ADX). It differs from TA-Lib by a convention, so these numbers are its own: Seeds the smoothed directional movement and true range with their sums over the first period bars; TA-Lib sums the first period - 1 and takes one smoothing step. The values differ at the start and converge as the smoothing forgets its seed (on the fixture's bars, by bar 280 at a period of 14). smoothing_method is accepted and does not change the numbers: the smoothing is always Wilder's, as TA-Lib's. Adds adxr (over adxr_lookback bars, none at its default of 0), di_diff and di_ratio, which these TA-Lib functions do not compute.
